climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Lake County AVA east of Clear Lake at 1,600 to 3,000 feet, with a valley floor and hillsides. Its east to west orientation, unusual for the Coast Range, comes from volcanic activity of Round Mountain, a dormant cinder cone.
